name: Water Elementals
summary: Following discoveries regarding the Stone of the Tides, Baron Revilgaz seeks a way to counteract the artifact's curse. He sends adventurers back to the island to harvest bracers from conjured water elementals so their magical residue can be inspected by experts.

sections.title: Curbing the Curse
sections.body: Believing the water elementals were summoned by the goblin wizard Gazban, Baron Revilgaz suspects their magical residue holds clues to dealing with the Stone of the Tides. The stone is said to curse anyone who wields it, causing the bearer to drift in and out of reality. To find a countermeasure, Revilgaz directs you back to the island off the coast to gather elemental bracers that might be scrutinized by the scholarly mages of Dalaran.

sections.title: Booty Bay's Master
sections.body: Upon receiving the bracers, Revilgaz admits he lacks the specialized expertise to tell whether any of them will be of use. Rather than travel to Dalaran himself—he will not leave Booty Bay just to chat with tiresome old mages—he sends you north to have a mage look at them.

faq.q: Who wants the water elemental bracers?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz, leader of the Blackwater Raiders in Booty Bay, asks for the bracers to investigate the magic surrounding the Stone of the Tides.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz need elemental bracers?
aliases: curse of the stone of the tides
faq.answer: He hopes that studying the magical residue on the bracers can reveal a method to counteract the curse of the Stone of the Tides, which causes its bearer to fade in and out of existence.
Baron Revilgaz believes they were conjured by Gazban, a goblin wizard said to have found the Stone of the Tides.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Next comes Magical Analysis: Revilgaz sends the bracers north to Dalaran so a mage can examine their residue.

faq.q: Why doesn't Revilgaz take the bracers to Dalaran himself?
faq.answer: He has no wish to leave Booty Bay just to chat with tiresome old mages, and he insists he has nothing to fear from would-be rivals.
